findings.title: Successful saved playback is below an empty live-camera panel
findings.observation: In the 1280x1556 review render, a disabled live-camera rectangle occupies approximately y277-788. Recorded playback starts around y823 and download actions around y839. findings.impact: A successful recording can look empty, and the person may enable the live camera again while trying to review the saved capture.
findings.recommendation: Use the main preview area for saved playback in review state, or promote a clear playback/download action before the empty live-preview block.
